blocks.text: IHD maloom ho to molecule ki composition (kis cheez se bana hai) aur structure (banawat) ke bare mein clues (ishare) mil jate hain. Maslan agar IHD 0 ho to yaqeeni hai ke compound mein na koi ring hai na koi double bond. Yeh bohat kaam ki baat hai, kyun ke yeh number sirf chemical formula dekh kar asaani se nikal aata hai.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text: Double bond aur ring dono aik aik IHD gine jate hain. Triple bond do IHD gina jata hai.

Agar IHD 1 ho to compound mein ya aik ring hai ya aik double bond, dono nahi ho sakte. Agar IHD 2 ho to kai options (soorten) hain: do rings, do double bonds, aik ring aur aik double bond, ya aik triple bond. Is tarah mushkil analytical techniques (tajziye ke tareeqon) ke baghair bhi IHD bohat maloomat deta hai. Kisi technique ko use karne se pehle IHD yeh faisla karne mein bhi madad deta hai ke is compound ke liye kaun si technique behtar hogi. Hydrocarbons ka IHD Table 29.1 ki madad se nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 29.1 Index of hydrogen deficiency
rows: 2 double bonds ya 2 rings ya 1 double bond aur 1 ring ya 1 triple bond

blocks.prompt: a) In ka IHD nikalein: i) C₆H₆ ii) C₆H₁₂ iii) C₄H₄. b) In ka structure propose karein (andaze se batayein).
blocks.explanation: i) C₆H₆: (2 × 6 + 2 − 6) / 2 = 4, maslan benzene (aik ring + teen C=C). ii) C₆H₁₂: (14 − 12) / 2 = 1, maslan hex-1-ene ya cyclohexane. iii) C₄H₄: (10 − 4) / 2 = 3, maslan but-1-en-3-yne, CH₂=CH–C≡CH (aik C=C + aik triple bond).

blocks.prompt: c) Hopanes petroleum products mein milne wale waxy (mom jaise) solids hain jo crude oil ki refining (saaf karne) ke baad residue (bachi hui cheez) ke taur par reh jate hain. Hopane ka formula C₃₀H₅₂ hai (kitab mein C₃₀H₆₂ chhapa hai). i) Is ka IHD nikalein. ii) Kya yeh saturated hai?
blocks.explanation: C₃₀H₅₂: (2 × 30 + 2 − 52) / 2 = 5. Hopane mein paanch rings hain aur koi double bond nahi, is liye yeh saturated hai. (Kitab ke formula C₃₀H₆₂ se IHD 0 aata hai: woh bhi saturated, lekin bina ring ke.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab hopane ka formula C₃₀H₆₂ likhti hai. Asal mein hopanes paanch rings wale saturated hydrocarbons hain jin ka formula C₃₀H₅₂ hai (IHD = 5). C₃₀H₆₂ to bina ring wale alkane ka formula hai (IHD = 0).

items: IHD = alkane CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ ke muqable kam hydrogen atoms ke pairs.
Har ring ya double bond = 1; triple bond = 2.
IHD 0: na ring na double bond.
